summary: 11 countries. Trade dominates the wires today as Washington bans Canadian drink, dairy and motorcycles and Ottawa's counter-tariffs bite, with knock-on stories from a Japanese brewery shifting production to a Chinese fund manager watching the Fed. Around that: the Iran sanctions campaign, Rubio in Colombia, a Republican midterms convention in Dallas, deportation flights into Equatorial Guinea, a UN vote to redraw the world map, an argument over who reaches AGI first, and the US Open.
